summary: Wipro Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval via postal ballot of a buyback of up to 600 million equity shares (5.72% of paid-up capital) at INR 250 per share, aggregate amount up to INR 150 billion (representing 24.99% and 19.99% of standalone and consolidated net worth). The buyback is a tender offer mechanism under Indian law, with e-voting from April 22 to May 21, 2026. The resolution passed by requisite majority. No advisor named. Watch for regulatory compliance with SEBI buyback norms and potential EPS accretion; risk-arb centers on execution risk and market price vs. buyback price INR 250.
